name: Damanos
description: Damanos was an ash-gray planet within the Damanos system, a star system in the Belderone sector of the Outer Rim Territories that contained a Sith castle. The former Sith Lord Maul, now turned crime lord, visited the planet during the Imperial Era, he discovered the secrets inside its Sith castle.
